title: Failure Is The Price Of Success | A Discipline Short Film
lines: Third rejection this month. His friends say, maybe it's a sign.
It is a sign. A sign that he's still trying.
Failure isn't the opposite of success.
It's the tax you pay for it.
So he wipes the rain from his face and walks back to the start.
Because the people you admire were not born ready.
They were rejected, ignored, and laughed at. And they kept showing up.
Rejection redirects you. Quitting ends you.
